title: Retrieving Patristic References and Modelling Topics in Bullinger's Reformation Correspondence
abstract: arXiv:2611.25247v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The correspondence of Heinrich Bullinger (1504-1575), Swiss Reformer and Antistes of Zurich, documents the political and religious debates of the Reformation, including extensive appeals to the Church Fathers as authoritative sources. Detecting such references computationally remains largely unexplored. We investigate dense and sparse retrieval for patristic reference detection, and metadata-informed topic modelling as a proxy for the topics and ideas discussed. Prior work on Latin intertextuality has fine-tuned dense retrievers for their respective target domain, and we test how well these models transfer to Bullinger's correspondence. We compare lexical (BM25), dense (bi-encoders), and hybrid methods on explicit and implicit references. translated_title: 在布林格的宗教改革书信中检索教父文献引用并建模主题
translated_abstract: 海因里希·布林格（1504-1575）是瑞士宗教改革家、苏黎世主教，他的书信记录了宗教改革时期的政治与宗教辩论，其中包括大量援引教父作为权威来源的内容。如何通过计算方法检测此类引用在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们研究了用于教父引用检测的稠密检索与稀疏检索方法，以及以元数据信息驱动的主题建模作为所讨论话题和思想的代理。此前关于拉丁语互文性的研究已针对各自目标领域对稠密检索器进行了微调，我们测试了这些模型向布林格书信的迁移效果。我们在显式引用和隐式引用上比较了词汇方法（BM25）、稠密方法（双编码器）和混合方法。在圣经文本复用上微调的拉丁语编码器在双编码器中表现最佳（显式引用的 Recall@20 为 82%，隐式引用为 16%），而 BM25 在显式引用上优于稠密方法。
tldr: 本研究首次将针对拉丁语圣经互文性微调的检索模型迁移至布林格宗教改革书信中的教父引用检测任务，通过比较词汇、稠密与混合检索方法，发现在圣经复用上微调的拉丁语编码器在双编码器中表现最佳，而 BM25 在显式引用检测上更具优势。
en_tdlr: This study transfers Latin encoders fine-tuned on biblical intertextuality to detect patristic references in Bullinger's Reformation correspondence, showing that a biblically fine-tuned Latin bi-encoder performs best on explicit and implicit references (82% and 16% Recall@20), while BM25 outperforms dense approaches on explicit citations.
